software-engineer.label: Software Engineer
software-engineer.summary: software engineer who builds and ships reliable web applications
highlights: Shipped features end to end, from design review through to production monitoring.
Reduced page load time by profiling and fixing the slowest rendering paths.
Wrote automated tests that caught regressions before release.

data-analyst.label: Data Analyst
data-analyst.summary: data analyst who turns messy datasets into decisions people act on
highlights: Built dashboards that replaced a weekly manual reporting pack.
Cleaned and joined datasets from several systems into one analysis-ready table.
Presented findings to non-technical stakeholders and recommended a next step.

registered-nurse.label: Registered Nurse
registered-nurse.summary: registered nurse delivering safe, compassionate patient care in a busy clinical setting
certifications: Registration with the relevant nursing council
highlights: Managed a patient caseload while keeping documentation accurate and on time.
Educated patients and families on discharge care, reducing avoidable readmissions.
Worked with the multidisciplinary team to escalate deteriorating patients early.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.summary: teacher who plans engaging lessons and gets measurable progress from every learner
highlights: Planned and delivered lessons across a full timetable with differentiated materials.
Used assessment data to target support where progress had stalled.
Ran an after-school club that increased learner engagement.

accountant.label: Accountant
accountant.summary: accountant who keeps books accurate, reconciles cleanly and prepares audit-ready reports
highlights: Prepared monthly management accounts and variance commentary for review.
Cleared reconciliation backlogs and documented the process so it stayed clean.
Supported an audit by assembling schedules and answering queries on time.

civil-engineer.label: Civil Engineer
civil-engineer.summary: civil engineer who designs and delivers safe, buildable infrastructure
highlights: Produced drawings and calculations checked against design codes.
Inspected site works and logged quality and safety issues for close-out.
Coordinated with contractors to keep a programme on schedule.

mechanical-engineer.label: Mechanical Engineer
mechanical-engineer.summary: mechanical engineer who designs, tests and improves mechanical systems
highlights: Designed and tested a component, iterating on the design after test data.
Diagnosed repeat equipment failures and proposed a fix that held.
Wrote maintenance procedures that technicians could follow safely.

marketing-specialist.label: Marketing Specialist
marketing-specialist.summary: marketing specialist who runs campaigns that bring in measurable leads
highlights: Planned and ran a multi-channel campaign from brief to report.
Wrote and edited copy that lifted email click-through.
Reported on channel performance and recommended where to spend next.

graphic-designer.label: Graphic Designer
graphic-designer.summary: graphic designer who turns a brief into clear, on-brand visual work
highlights: Delivered print and digital assets from a single brief and brand guide.
Built reusable design components so the team stopped rebuilding the same layouts.
Prepared files for print with correct bleed, colour and resolution.

lawyer.label: Lawyer / Legal Graduate
lawyer.summary: legal professional who researches thoroughly and writes advice people can act on
highlights: Researched case law and statute and summarised the position in a short memo.
Reviewed contracts and flagged clauses that carried commercial risk.
Kept matter files and deadlines in order across several active matters.

social-worker.label: Social Worker
social-worker.summary: social worker who assesses need and coordinates support for vulnerable people
highlights: Held a caseload and kept assessments and case notes up to date.
Worked with partner agencies to put a support plan in place.
Supported a person through a crisis and followed up until they were stable.

pharmacist.label: Pharmacist
pharmacist.summary: pharmacist who dispenses safely and gives patients advice they understand
highlights: Checked and dispensed prescriptions accurately during high-volume periods.
Counselled patients on correct use, side effects and interactions.
Kept stock records and expiry checks compliant with regulation.

agricultural-scientist.label: Agricultural Scientist
agricultural-scientist.summary: agricultural scientist who improves yields with field trials and evidence
highlights: Ran field trials and recorded yield data across treatments and seasons.
Analysed results and recommended a practice change to growers.
Worked with smallholders to apply findings in the field.

project-manager.label: Project Manager
project-manager.summary: project manager who keeps scope, budget and people moving in the same direction
highlights: Ran a project plan with clear owners, milestones and dependencies.
Tracked budget and flagged overruns before they became problems.
Kept stakeholders updated with a short weekly report.
